name: lovelivelife
source:
A girl notices a slightly gloomy boy she hadn’t paid much attention to before.
On a rainy day, he’s holding a stray cat and smiling gently at it.
Though it’s a cliché scene, her heart skips a beat, and she struggles to get closer to him.

[Translated from [url=https://lllakolll.xxxxxxxx.jp/lll/lovelivelife.html]official website[/url]]
